distribution.summary: 中国大陆（区域记录，未细化至省级）；台湾
distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) gives the source distribution as China (SE, SW, WP); Taiwan and reports the first Taiwan record from Ilan, Fushan and Nantou, Neimoupu. Broad regional wording is not expanded into provinces.

host_note: The source states only that the species is polyphagous on angiosperms; no individual host taxon is inferred.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Coccotrypes longior (Eggers, 1927).
